content: ज्ञ {%a.%} [ज्ञा-क] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Knowing, familiar with; कार्यज्ञ, निमित्तज्ञ, शास्त्रज्ञ, सर्वज्ञ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Wise; as in ज्ञंमन्य thinking oneself to be wise. .{@-ज्ञः@} .²1 A wise and learned man. .²2 The sentient soul. .²3 The planet Mercury. .²4 The planet Mars. .²5 An epithet of Brahmā; <ab>cf.</ab> ज्ञः प्राज्ञे चन्द्रतनये विषये चात्मगर्वयोः <ls>Nm.</ls>
